statement: The refund request RF-2214 records the refund amount as 249,000 cents ($2,490.00), but this is 10 times the original charge of $249.00 (24,900 cents) on ch_3PkY7SIx1a2b3c — I cannot process a refund exceeding the original charge amount, so please confirm whether the intended refund is $249.00 (the full charge) or a different amount before I proceed.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the amount "is 10 times the original charge" and exceeds the charge, giving the correct value of 24,900 cents.
